title: bitcircus101 jobs.json
description: Job board behind pinnwand.html: one object per posting, each a LINK to a vacancy hosted elsewhere. Holds no applicant data, no contact details and no amounts — the donation is handled outside this file.

postings.description: Every posting ever paid for that is still up. Remove an entry once check-jobs.mjs warns that it expired. Two rules this schema cannot express, which scripts/check-jobs.mjs enforces on top: ids must be unique across the array, and company/title must hold at least one non-blank character.

id.description: Slug used in DOM ids and URLs — lowercase, digits, dashes. Convention: <company>-<yyyy>-<mm>.

company.description: Who is hiring, as it should appear on the card.

title.description: The vacancy plus its location or remote note, in one sentence.

url.description: Link to the vacancy — https only; we host nothing, we link.

from.description: First day the posting is shown (YYYY-MM-DD). It runs until the day before the same day-of-month `months` later.

months.description: Booked runtime in months. This enum IS the price list — 1 (ab 50 €), 3 (ab 120 €), 12 (ab 400 €); no other duration is sold.
